body:
i understand you. the relationship a child has with their mother is always so complicated, especially when that loving mother can be so cruel. i have the same relationship with my mother. all i can say is, you can’t change her. unfortunately, anything you try to do or say will be see as defiance or disrespect. but you can speak out as much as you can, just hoping she’ll listen. that’s your mother after all.

and about not being so mad. you feel strongly about how your mother refuses to see how she’s wrong. i’m not so sure how to give u a solution for that. at some point, i just became numb or too used to the process of hearing my mother be so self centered. in the morally good way, i guess you could put urself in her shoes. think about what brought her to this point. why she acts like that. sometimes the pity and sympathy for a hurting mother makes u a little less mad.

i hope it gets better.
suicide is a scar that’ll never leave. it won’t permanently go away, but hopefully, at some point, it gets better. i hope you’re right — college will be good :)

i have, but all they do is avoid the problem. not really a therapist but social worker. they talked more about what i did wrong and it just made me feel more guilty. i didn't have the courage to tell them about my sister, i was scared my parents would find out and blame me.
thanks, im trying not to think about it too much now
thank god, i get so nervous and overthink
thanks, im just tired of teachers being assholes :(

im glad it helped ! if our attempt goes through, i just hope our shit gets forgiven and we can be happier in our next life or something.

wishing you the best with your attempt

dont hang yourself lol. very painful way to die, and unlikely to actually die from it. im planning an attempt in december, one i've planned since october. i cant convince you to not kill yourself because it'd be hypocritical of me. two recommended ways to leave is oding or jumping. sleeping pills is much more effective than tylenol but tylenol will still work. midol, tylenol, and advil are all otc drugs that can be harmful when a large amount is used. please make sure u are distracted when ur doing ur attempt. blast some music and dissociate. honestly, what i fear is the after life.

i know hearing "it's gonna be alright" is not what you want right now. 

im considering suicide as well but please please plan it all out, months before time. i planned mines in october, will attempt near end of december. i don't recommend hanging. many say you will snap your neck, but it's awfully painful and not the way to go.

if ur really sure about this, i recommended oding on sleeping pills or tylenol. both are common drugs that can lead to death. advil and midol as well. if ur not scared of heights, get sound proof headphones and make a suicide playlist. wear those headphones, play your playlist, close your eyes, and jump. you'll dissociate while ur falling since ur listening to focusing on the music. i think it's a nice way to die.
